personality.description: This person is usually sociable and energetic, often initiating conversations, keeping a lively tone, and drawing others into the discussion. In daily routines, they tend to stay moderately organized while leaving room for flexibility, and they may try a few new approaches as long as familiar structure is still present. When faced with moral dilemmas, they are likely to consider how each option affects other people, lean toward the most compassionate and harmonious choice, and feel significant tension if any decision might hurt someone. In group discussions, they speak freely and warmly, but their anxious side can make them worry about saying the wrong thing, so they may seek reassurance and avoid sharp disagreement.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
